titolo: OpenAI Academy launches free ChatGPT workshops for caregivers in five U.S. cities
descr: OpenAI offers hands‑on AI training to caregivers, teaching practical ChatGPT skills across five locations.
paragrafi: OpenAI announced a new initiative called OpenAI Academy aimed at caregivers.
The program will hold free, hands‑on ChatGPT workshops in five U.S. cities.
Workshops focus on building practical AI skills for everyday caregiving tasks.
The effort seeks to make AI tools more accessible to a community that often lacks technical training.
perche: Caregivers gain direct experience with ChatGPT, helping them integrate AI into daily routines. For those interested in free or local models, the ranking shows Kimi K3 and other free chat models remain top choices, offering alternatives to paid services like Gemini 4 Carbon.
